name: Meravia
tagline: The coordination fabric for the world's aging population.
positioning: Meravia unifies caregivers, clinicians, and families onto one orchestration layer — turning fragmented elder-care into a single, auditable continuum of care across every facility you operate.

hero.h1: Every hand of care, moving as one.
hero.sub: Meravia is the orchestration layer for enterprise elder-care — connecting home aides, care managers, clinicians, and families into a single living record. Coordinate thousands of care journeys with the precision of one.

features.title: Unified care continuum
features.description: Replace the shift-notes binder and the group text with one authoritative timeline. Every visit, medication change, and family message lands in a single record your entire network can trust.

features.title: Signal before crisis
features.description: Meravia reads patterns across visits — missed meals, gait changes, escalating pain scores — and surfaces the resident who needs attention before the 2 a.m. call ever comes.

features.title: Family in the loop
features.description: Give adult children a calm, real-time window into their parent's day. Fewer anxious phone calls to your care managers, higher renewal on your premium plans.

features.title: Regulatory-grade audit trail
features.description: Every action is timestamped, attributed, and export-ready. Survey season becomes a query, not a fire drill across seventeen facilities.

features.title: Staffing that self-heals
features.description: When an aide calls out, Meravia rebalances the route, notifies the covering caregiver, and preserves care continuity — no dispatcher scrambling.

features.title: Network intelligence
features.description: Benchmark outcomes, response times, and cost-per-journey across your entire portfolio from one command view built for regional and system leaders.

testimonials.quote: Before Meravia, coordinating 4,200 home-care journeys meant nine disconnected systems and a prayer. Now it's one continuum. Our hospitalization rate dropped 19% in the first two quarters.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The audit trail alone justified the contract. What used to take my team three weeks to assemble for a state survey now exports in an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Marcus Elrey

testimonials.quote: Families finally stopped calling our care managers ten times a day. The transparency layer changed the entire tenor of our relationships — and our renewals.
testimonials.name: Priya Natarajan

pricing.blurb: For regional operators bringing their first facilities onto one continuum.
For multi-site systems standardizing care across the portfolio.
For national systems running Meravia as core infrastructure.

homepage.footerBlurb: Meravia is building the coordination fabric for the world's aging population — one continuous, humane record of care across every hand that touches a life.
